name: Eastwall Bone Collective
description: The newest and most rapidly ascending stable in GLMZ's underground combat scene, the Eastwall Bone Collective was established in 2222 in the industrial Tier 1-2 Eastwall corridor by a group of former IRONWALL LEAGUE support staff who were collectively laid off when Axiom Group automated the Crown District's arena maintenance operations. They operate in the REDLINE underground circuit and have already produced two fighters who have drawn significant sanctioned-league recruitment offers.
story_hooks: One of the Bone Collective's founders is secretly in contact with the IRONWALL LEAGUE, providing information about underground circuit operations in exchange for a promise of reinstatement — and the others are beginning to suspect.
A Bone Collective fighter accepts a covert sanctioned-league recruitment offer and must decide how to leave without destroying the community they helped build.
The 2224 raid's aftermath has left three Collective members facing serious charges — the only lawyer willing to take the case pro bono has their own complicated agenda.
